one_liner: Pipedrive has a broad REST API (v1/v2) with OAuth 2.0 and API tokens, OpenAPI specs, and an official vendor-run MCP server; API token is included with every plan, with a 14-day trial for new accounts.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow plus a static personal API token obtained manually from the Pipedrive app.
access_notes: The homepage offers a 14-day free trial, no credit card. A developer sandbox account can be requested. No permanent free plan is confirmed by the pages.
blocker_notes: No permanent free plan; a trial, paid seat or requested sandbox is needed for working credentials.

evidence.quote: An official, reliable and fully supported connection built and maintained by Pipedrive.
Enter Pipedrive MCP as the app name and in the **”Connection”** field enter [https://mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp](https://mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp).
14-day free trial, no credit card required
Go to [the Developer Sandbox Account](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/developer-sandbox-account) page to learn more and request your own sandbox account.
The API token can be [obtained](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/how-to-find-the-api-token) manually from the Pipedrive app.
you may be prompted to sign in to your Pipedrive account and authorize access.
you can always import our OpenAPI 3 specification files
